chunks: Let none of you beware lest he hinder his brother from hajj (pilgrimage), and then a trial afflict him in his worldly life, along with what is stored up for him in the Hereafter.

key_terms.أَخَاهُ: his brother, meaning a fellow believer
key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.فِتْنَةٌ: a trial, affliction, or worldly tribulation
key_terms.يُعَوِّقَ: to hinder, obstruct, or hold back

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about preventing someone from performing hajj (pilgrimage)?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام warns against obstructing another believer from performing hajj (pilgrimage). The hadith teaches that such interference can bring punishment both in this world and in the Hereafter.
